scope: Minimal f989-to-integrated-v3 corpus adoption: exact source and plugin corpus identity, 78 published plus 2 excluded candidates, four reserved holdout metadata records preserved, targeted knowledge index tests, 12 frozen AIK cases on two backends in default/domain modes, and four matrix development query spot checks. Upstream raw evidence is reused only for its actual eight-case legacy scope; no scientific, model, performance, automatic-recovery, or full-catalog claim.

implementation.procedure: Compare actual corpus/evaluator/runtime bytes with remote f989 and inspect every changed ranking dependency; only index-write guarding may differ. Inspect candidate exclusion and exercise targeted index tests.
implementation.acceptance: Exact corpus and plugin mirror, unchanged ranking definitions and evaluators, exact published index IDs, no candidate exposure.

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare four current matrix query results against remote raw rows; compare AIK results with immutable concurrent-base raw rows and final-base summary. Inspect both holdout registries before metadata and body access.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Targets and metadata remain fixed; inherited failures remain visible; mismatches are reported without claim expansion.

data_integrity.procedure: Bind code, corpus, metadata, plugin, old result records, upstream reports and raw data. Confirm all prior entry files and upstream current reports preserved. Recompute row denominators and metrics.
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing or altered source evidence; actual upstream eight-case scope used despite prose claiming 21; one new native record remains pending independent review.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Check 80 total equals 78 published plus 2 candidates, exact SQLite ID set, finite query metrics, 24 rows per AIK mode, and four matrix cases per backend.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Counts, identities, hit totals, failures and denominators agree with raw observations.

measurement_validity.procedure: Separate historical reuse from fresh deterministic development retrieval; retain all failure rows and raw timing fields without performance inference.
measurement_validity.acceptance: No unseen-test, scientific adoption, automatic recovery, full legacy catalog or performance claim; historical scope and changed corpus limitations explicit.

reproducibility.procedure: Freeze exact commands, environment, source hashes and output hashes before independent final review; verify dependencies stable across this run.
reproducibility.acceptance: Commands are reproducible within the stated standard-library/SQLite environment; no self-issued independent acceptance.
